# Pixera
> Pixera is a macOS screenshot editor that turns raw captures into polished assets for product launches, changelogs, docs, support replies, social posts, and internal reviews.

## Product Positioning
Pixera is the layer you use after capture when a screenshot needs to look intentional. It combines styling, annotation, privacy cleanup, and export framing in one offline macOS workflow.

## Core Capabilities
- Blur and gradient screenshot backgrounds
- Adaptive insets, rounded corners, and polished framing
- Screenshot annotation with arrows, labels, and callouts
- On-device privacy redaction for emails, API keys, customer details, and other sensitive text
- Export-ready screenshots for launch pages, documentation, tutorials, support, and social media

## Primary Audiences
- Product marketers publishing polished launch visuals
- Developers and founders documenting product workflows
- Support teams sharing clear screenshot-based instructions
- Designers and creators who want screenshots to feel branded without using a full design tool

## Messaging Guardrails
- Pixera is a macOS app
- Privacy and redaction workflows are on-device
- Checkout completes off-domain via Lemon Squeezy
- Position Pixera as a screenshot editor and presentation workflow, not a general-purpose design suite
- Comparison pages should stay dated, specific, and honest about feature differences because competitor pricing, localized currencies, and positioning can change
